qualifier: growth control via progenitor cell proliferation
name: Kidney growth control via progenitor cell proliferation
rationale: All members regulate kidney/metanephros development or size, and unlike the confusables (apoptosis, mesenchymal differentiation, nephric duct/ureter) this theme centres on renal cell proliferation, stem cell maintenance and glomerular growth.

qualifier: with vocal, social and sensorimotor behavior
name: MECP2 chromatin repression with vocal and sensorimotor behavior
rationale: Members combine MECP2 DNA/NCoR binding, HDAC repression and target regulation with the vocal, auditory, social and prepulse-inhibition behaviors it affects, whereas confusables carry only the molecular MECP2 part or only the behaviors.

name: Nephric duct, ureter and kidney development regulation
rationale: Members regulate meso/metanephros development and kidney size together with nephric duct, epithelial tube and ureter morphogenesis, lacking the ureteric bud branching and proliferation/apoptosis content of the confusables.

name: Hematopoietic stem cell self-renewal and division control
rationale: All members concern HSC proliferation, division, homeostasis and population maintenance (including LIF response), without the erythroid, megakaryocytic or bone-marrow apoptosis content of the confusables.

name: Cardiac depolarization and His-Purkinje conduction
rationale: Members regulate atrial, ventricular and AV-node depolarization and His-to-Purkinje-to-ventricle signaling, distinct from the confusables' repolarization phases, potassium channels and SA-node pacemaking.

name: GPCR-cAMP regulation of islet hormone secretion
rationale: Members are incretin, glucagon, calcitonin/amylin/CGRP, fatty acid, HCA and somatostatin receptor signaling via adenylate cyclase that regulates insulin, glucagon and growth hormone secretion, whereas confusables emphasise KATP channels, adrenergic inhibition or intracellular fatty acid metabolism.

name: Granulocyte lineage commitment from myeloid progenitors
rationale: Members cover myeloid progenitor proliferation and differentiation toward neutrophils, eosinophils and mast cells under G-CSF/GM-CSF, RUNX1 and VENTX control while restraining monocyte/macrophage fates, unlike the macrophage, monocyte-trafficking and erythro-megakaryocytic confusables.

name: Sensory, vocal and social behavior with striatum-amygdala development
rationale: Members are auditory, visual, tactile, vocal, social and psychomotor behaviors plus striatum and amygdala development, distinguished from mating/grooming, locomotor and molecular MECP2 confusables.

name: Omega-3-derived resolvin and protectin biosynthesis
rationale: All members synthesise DHA/EPA-derived D- and E-series resolvins and protectins, whereas confusables cover arachidonate-derived lipoxins, HETEs, hepoxilins and leukotriene catabolism.

name: Axon pathfinding of commissural and long-range projection tracts
rationale: Members describe guidance of commissural, retinal, corticospinal, dopaminergic and serotonergic axons and tract morphogenesis at the process level, unlike the confusables' molecular SLIT-ROBO, netrin, ephrin and L1 signaling.

name: Androgen receptor signaling and sex steroid response
rationale: Members are androgen and estrogen response programs centred on AR signaling (testosterone response, KLK2/3, prostate epithelium, HSP90-SHR cycle), which the estrogen-receptor-focused confusables lack.

name: Mast cell degranulation and FcεRI calcium mobilization
rationale: All members concern mast cell differentiation, activation, histamine release and FcεRI/LAT2 calcium mobilization in type I hypersensitivity, distinct from FcεRI MAPK/NF-kB cytokine and Th2/eosinophil confusables.

name: COPII ER-to-Golgi vesicle cargo loading and tethering
rationale: Members cover COPII coating, ER cargo concentration and vesicle targeting/tethering to the Golgi, whereas confusables are COPI retrograde and intra-Golgi traffic.

qualifier: Th1 and regulatory T cell responses
name: Regulation of interleukin production and Th1/Treg responses
rationale: Members mostly restrain IL-12, IL-2, IL-21, IL-6, IL-1b and TNF production and Th1/Treg differentiation while modulating IL-10 and activated T cell proliferation, unlike the TLR/NF-kB inhibition and T cell suppression confusables.

name: Purine nucleobase salvage and nucleoside catabolism
rationale: Members are PRPP-dependent HPRT/APRT salvage and ADA/PNP-driven adenosine, inosine and guanine breakdown to allantoin, distinct from de novo purine synthesis and deoxynucleotide triphosphate confusables.

name: Synaptic excitability modulation by Gβγ channels and nicotinic receptors
rationale: Members tune pre/extrasynaptic membrane potential via Gβγ-gated K+ and Ca2+ channels, presynaptic kainate and extrasynaptic GABA, and uniquely include nicotinic acetylcholine receptors absent from all confusables.

core: Membrane transport of carboxylates and organic ions
qualifier: dicarboxylate shuttles and renal organic ion transport
name: Dicarboxylate shuttles and renal organic ion transport
rationale: Members transport succinate, alpha-ketoglutarate, malate-aspartate, pyruvate and organic anions/cations including proximal tubule development, unlike carnitine, monocarboxylate/lactate and cationic amino acid confusables.

qualifier: IL-2, IL-7 and IL-9 in T cells
name: IL-2, IL-7 and IL-9 signaling in T cells
rationale: Members are IL-2/STAT5, IL-7 and IL-9 signaling with T cell activation and gamma-delta T cell differentiation, distinct from IL-6/gp130, IL-3/IL-5 and IL-15/IL-21 NK-cell confusables.

name: Skeletal muscle differentiation, dystroglycan complex and neuromuscular junction
rationale: Members combine myogenesis, muscle fiber differentiation and homeostasis with dystrophin-glycoprotein complex formation, ECM proteoglycans and NMJ/AChR clustering, unlike basement membrane, contraction, atrophy and DAG1 glycosylation confusables.

name: Clathrin-coated vesicle cycling and lysosome-related organelle biogenesis
rationale: Members are clathrin coat assembly/disassembly, cargo loading and synaptic vesicle endocytosis plus melanosome and dense granule biogenesis, which the active-zone, lysosomal targeting and organelle-tethering confusables lack.

name: Cysteinyl leukotriene synthesis, transport and receptor signaling
rationale: Members cover LTC4/LTD4 synthesis, transport and CysLT receptor signaling (with prostaglandin D response), distinct from LTB4/lipoxin catabolism and histamine/prostanoid receptor confusables.

qualifier: SLC35 Golgi transport and GPI anchoring
name: Nucleotide sugar synthesis, SLC35 transport and GPI anchoring
rationale: Members synthesise UDP-GlcNAc, GDP-fucose, CMP-sialic acid and UDP-glucuronate, transport them via SLC35-family carriers and build GPI anchors, unlike the N-glycan, dolichol, glycosphingolipid and lysosomal catabolism confusables.

qualifier: complex III-IV and cytochrome oxidase assembly
name: Complex III-IV electron transfer and cytochrome oxidase assembly
rationale: Members cover ubiquinol-to-oxygen electron transport, chemiosmotic ATP formation and complex IV/respirasome assembly, lacking the complex I/III biogenesis and mitochondrial translation of the confusables.

name: Fucosylated glycan antigens and selectin-mediated leukocyte homing
rationale: Members are ABO/Lewis fucosylated oligosaccharide synthesis and fucose metabolism with protein sulfation, leukocyte rolling and HSC bone marrow homing, unlike the N-/O-glycan elongation and sialylation confusables.

name: ER-associated degradation and misfolded protein quality control
rationale: Members regulate ERAD, reticulophagy, protein unfolding and misfolded protein responses (including Josephin DUBs), distinct from ubiquitin-chain, aggrephagy, stress granule and ribosome quality control confusables.
